description: Returns views, likes, replies and followers for one account over a period (7d, 30d; default 30d). account_id is required; "all" returns the organization-wide aggregate. views_scope is lifetime, posts_scope is the period. Applies when the user asks how an account is performing.

account_id.description: Account id from list_accounts, or "all" for the organization-wide aggregate
